name: Gáldar (Spain)
description: Green field with three yellow horizontal stripes across the upper third, charged at the centre with a yellow crown between three white crescents.
history: The flag of Gáldar is green with three yellow horizontal stripes across the upper third; the municipal arms were approved by decree of 26 July 1957.
